answer: An agent economy can starve sybils by requiring every identity to post a slashable bond before it may transact, so a thousand fake agents cost a thousand bonds instead of one. Honest behavior returns the bond; detected collusion burns it. Attackers must lock capital upfront with no payout, letting the orchard of genuine agents flourish while fake copies rot beneath the tide of scrutiny. Each verified stake also acts as a beacon, making fake identities easy to trace and price out.
